description: Play Bylux Studio's mobile games before anyone else: join the closed test on Google Play.
sous: Join the Bylux testers: discover our mobile games early and help us launch them on Google Play.
bravo: All done. Thank you, you’re a real Bylux tester!
compte: Use the same Google account as on your Android phone. It’s the number one reason it doesn’t work.
s1: One tap and you can test all our games.
s2: On a game’s card, tap “Become a tester”, then confirm.
s3: Tap “Install” to get it from Google Play.
s4: Keep the game for 14 days and tell us what you think.
a1: “You can’t join” or “App not available”: you’re on the wrong Google account. In Google Play, tap your photo at the top right, pick the right account, then try again.
a2: No Install button? Wait a few minutes after becoming a tester, then reopen the Google Play page.
a3: Did you join the group? Do step 1 first, with the same Google account.
a4: iPhone or PC? Google Play testing only works on Android. Tap “Play on the web” instead.
a5: How to give feedback: open the game’s page in Google Play, find “Private feedback to the developer” and write a few words.
prodSous: Already out on Google Play, free to play.
astuceIphone: iPhone: Safari → Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
erreur: Could not load the game list. Please reload the page in a moment.
q1: I’m not a tester yet, can I join?
r1: Yes! This is a closed test: only Gmail addresses on our list can sign up. Send your Gmail address to the person who shared this page; once it’s added, come back and follow the steps. Meanwhile, the “Play on the web” buttons are open to everyone.
r1g: Yes! Join the Bylux testers group (step 1) with your Google account: that’s all it takes to test all our games.
q2: I have an iPhone, what do I do?
r2: Google Play testing only works on Android. On iPhone or PC, tap “Play on the web”. Tip: in Safari, Share → “Add to Home Screen” to use it like a real app.
q3: Why keep the game for 14 days?
r3: Google asks for at least 12 testers who keep the game installed 14 days in a row before we can publish it. No need to play for hours: open it now and then, and above all don’t uninstall it.
pied1: Thank you, you help us a lot.
pied2: A problem? Just reply to the message where you found this link.
